_note: status=documented: value is stated in the National Cancer Strategy or roadmap. status=placeholder: invented for the prototype, must be replaced or justified.

screening_target.source: Strategy 2026-2035 p.5; Roadmap p.48 (80 % participation in every wellbeing services county)

distance_far_km.source: Roadmap p.13 (less palliative radiotherapy beyond 100 km; worse outcomes already beyond 50 km)

treatment_within_target_min.source: Strategy p.5 only says patients start treatment within target times; cancer-specific times are to be defined 2026-2028 (Roadmap p.57). The target days themselves are placeholders inside generate.py

delay_ratio.source: Stage delay counts as a gap when the regional median is this many times the national median

early_stage_gap_pp.source: Gap vs national median per cancer. The documented target (70 % stage I-II, Strategy p.5) is for all cancers combined

foreign_language_share_high.source: Roadmap p.11 documents lower screening participation among people born abroad, but gives no cut-off

education_gap_pp.source: Difference between high and low education groups

primary_care_wait_high_days.source: Separates a capacity problem from a referral-criteria problem

vacancy_high.source: Separates a workforce problem from a process problem
